title: Nutty Crunchy Slovakian Pork Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful one-pot stew featuring pork, mustard, and sesame seed oil, with a crunchy texture from toasted nuts, this dish is perfect for a cold winter night. It is also FODMAP friendly.
instructions: Heat the sesame seed oil in a large pot over medium high heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the mustard and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth, carrots, and potatoes, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the toasted almonds and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Shock the stew in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Serve hot, garnished with additional toasted almonds if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
